qabalism.m: Another spelling of cabalism. cabalism: adherence to some extreme traditional theological concept or interpretation.

qanat.m: An underground conduit, between vertical shafts, that leads water from the interior of a hill to villages in the valley.

qanats.m: More than one qanat. qanat: an underground conduit, between vertical shafts, that leads water from the interior of a hill to villages in the valley.
